rules.isobmff:error: Outcome equals the manifest expectation (manifest expect=ok)
rules.isobmff:trackSelection: Same real video tracks and primary track as ffprobe (attached_pic excluded; MP4/MOV: enabled tracks only)
rules.isobmff:formatDurationSec: format.duration within 1e-6 s; skipped when subtitle or data tracks exist
rules.isobmff:avgFps: avgFpsFfprobe (the duration-sum rational) must equal avg_frame_rate exactly
rules.isobmff:avgFps.measured: Presented average (presented frames / presentation span) must equal avgFromPts within 1e-9 relative; within-tol when the frames match and the spans differ by less than one median frame delta (ffprobe filled the last packet duration)
rules.isobmff:nominalFps: Exact vs r_frame_rate, only when the track is CFR (stage 1); otherwise skipped
rules.isobmff:frames: Exact vs nb_frames (non-fragmented); fragmented: vs nb_read_packets; hybrid: total vs nb_read_packets
rules.isobmff:durationSec: Exact vs duration_ts x time_base; fragmented with sidx: within max(1 frame, abs(start_time))
rules.isobmff:minFps: Exact rational vs the tail-excluded reference minimum
rules.isobmff:maxFps: Exact rational vs the tail-excluded reference maximum
rules.isobmff:isVfr: Equal to the reference VFR flag (shared rule, tolerance max(1 tick, 0.5% of the median delta))
rules.isobmff:duplicateTimestamps: Equal to the reference count of deltas that are 0 or less
rules.matroska:error: Outcome equals the manifest expectation (manifest expect=ok)
rules.matroska:trackSelection: Same real video tracks and primary track as ffprobe (attached_pic excluded; MP4/MOV: enabled tracks only)
rules.matroska:formatDurationSec: Exact vs format.duration when Info Duration exists; ffprobe N/A is not compared
rules.matroska:avgFps.declared: Declared rate string must equal avg_frame_rate exactly when DefaultDuration exists
rules.matroska:avgFps.measured: Measured average must equal avgFromPts (integer-ms last duration) within 1e-9 relative
rules.matroska:nominalFps: Declared rate string must equal r_frame_rate exactly when DefaultDuration exists; otherwise skipped
rules.matroska:frames: Exact vs nb_read_packets (ffprobe prints nb_frames N/A)
rules.matroska:presentedFrames: Exact vs nb_read_frames (equals the block count)
rules.matroska:durationSec: ffprobe prints no duration for Matroska video streams; the DURATION tag is shown for information only
rules.matroska:startSec: Exact vs start_pts x time_base once every block timestamp has been read (exact scan); otherwise skipped
